policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Chad's current official notices make new visitor-visa applications exclusively electronic before travel; Czech visitors are visa-subject rather than visa-exempt.
conditions: Apply through Chad's official eVisa platform before travel; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
The policy does not infer a visa exemption: it applies to the ordinary Czech visitor needing a Chad visa.
Approval, documentary, health, security, carrier and final border-admission checks remain applicable.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express.
steps: Submit the ordinary Czech-passport visitor application online before travel.
Travel only after issuance and retain the required supporting documents.
